name: IP Recon
summary: Enriches IP Address nodes with RDAP allocation, Shodan InternetDB open ports/CVEs/hostnames/tags, and geolocation.
description:
Passive enrichment for IP Address nodes from three free, keyless public sources: who the address is registered to (RDAP), what Shodan has seen exposed on it (InternetDB), and roughly where it is (ipwho.is). It complements the IP to ASN (Team Cymru - DoH Based) pack, which covers routing.

## Plugins

### RDAP IP

- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes.
- **Adds:** a Netblock node (`cidr`, `network_name`, `country_code`) linked `within netblock`, and fills the IP's `organization` and `country_code` when they are empty.
- **How:** queries `https://rdap.org/ip/<ip>`, which redirects to the authoritative regional registry (ARIN, RIPE NCC, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC). The CIDR comes from the `cidr0_cidrs` extension; without it the netblock is recorded as a `start - end` address range. The organization is the registrant when that is an organization, otherwise the network's description remark (where KRNIC and JPNIC name the holder), never the administrative contact.
- **Notes:** the selection is ordered round-robin across registries, using a copy of IANA's RDAP bootstrap embedded in the pack, so no one registry gets a burst of requests. Within one run, an address inside an end assignment that was already fetched reuses that answer; allocations are never reused, because they can hold more specific registrations. Nothing is kept between runs. One Netblock node per CIDR.

### Shodan InternetDB

- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes.
- **Adds:**
  - a Host node keyed on the IP, with `open_ports` and, when a CPE names one, `operating_system`, linked `exposes`;
  - a Vulnerability node per CVE ID InternetDB lists, linked `affected by`;
  - a Domain node per reverse hostname, linked `resolves to`;
  - Shodan's tags for the IP (for example `cdn`, `cloud`, `honeypot`, `self-signed`), written onto the IP Address as `shodan_tags`, the key the Shodan Host plugin also writes.
- **Notes:** reads `https://internetdb.shodan.io/<ip>`. A 404 means InternetDB has no data for that address; the address is skipped.

### IP Geolocation

- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes.
- **Adds:** a Location node (`name`, `city`, `region`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`) linked `geolocated to`, and fills the IP's `country_code` and `organization` (the ISP ipwho.is reports) when they are empty.
- **Notes:** reads `https://ipwho.is/<ip>`. IP geolocation is approximate; verify it before relying on it.

All three plugins write only the fields they have values for, and never overwrite a known field with a blank. A lookup that fails or returns nothing is skipped and the run continues.

## Requirements

- No API key, account or token.
- Runs in the web app; the desktop app is not needed, because every endpoint answers cross-origin requests.
- Uses `infrastructure.ip_address`, `infrastructure.netblock`, `infrastructure.host` and `infrastructure.domain` (Infrastructure type pack), `threat.vulnerability` (Threat) and `geo.location` (Geo).

## Cost and limits

The repository describes all three endpoints as free and keyless, and states no rate limits for them. Each plugin sends one request per selected address, one at a time; RDAP IP sends fewer when an earlier answer in the same run already covers an address.

## What it contacts

| Plugin | Service | What it receives |
|---|---|---|
| RDAP IP | rdap.org, then the regional registry it redirects to | each selected IP address |
| Shodan InternetDB | internetdb.shodan.io | each selected IP address |
| IP Geolocation | ipwho.is | each selected IP address |

Requests go out from the analyst's own Vineyard client; the pack has no server in between. The addresses under investigation are never contacted: every lookup is passive.

## Data and licences

Results are third-party data: registration records from the regional internet registries (through RDAP), Shodan InternetDB, and ipwho.is. This repository does not restate their terms of use. The registry table embedded in the pack is taken from IANA's RDAP bootstrap.

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-ip-recon (Apache-2.0). `dist/pack.mjs` is built from `src/` with a pinned esbuild (`node build.mjs`), so the published bundle can be checked against the source.

plugins.name: RDAP IP
plugins.description: Looks up each selected IP Address in RDAP. Creates a Netblock node (CIDR, network name, country) linked "within netblock" and fills the IP's organization and country_code if empty.

network.purpose: Look up each selected IP's netblock and owner in RDAP.

plugins.name: Shodan InternetDB
plugins.description: Looks up each selected IP Address in Shodan InternetDB. Creates a Host node with the open ports (and OS when known) linked "exposes", Vulnerability nodes for known CVEs linked "affected by", and Domain nodes for reverse hostnames linked "resolves to", and writes Shodan's tags for the IP (e.g. cdn, cloud, honeypot, self-signed) onto it as shodan_tags.

network.purpose: Look up open ports, known CVEs, hostnames and tags for each selected IP in Shodan InternetDB.

plugins.name: IP Geolocation
plugins.description: Geolocates each selected IP Address via ipwho.is. Creates a Location node (city, region, country, latitude/longitude) linked "geolocated to" and fills the IP's country_code and organization if empty.

network.purpose: Look up each selected IP's approximate location and ISP.
